entities.summary: Powell Foulk Clayton was an American politician, diplomat, and businessman who served as the ninth governor of Arkansas from 1868 to 1871, as a Republican United States Senator for Arkansas from 1871 to 1877 and as United States Ambassador to Mexico from 1897 to 1905.
